g.text: PostgreSQL 18 Lock-Ordering Hierarchy & Real Bugs Caught
Enforced acquisition order across 10 FOR UPDATE queries, 2 advisory namespaces & 5 @Version entities — plus 6 subtle concurrency bugs proved & fixed
Isolated REQUIRES_NEW pre/post tx — never overlaps domain locks
Sorted asset IDs prevent AB/BA bundle deadlocks; scalar read bypasses L1 cache
Reservation ALWAYS locked before Asset and Transfer (#270, #329)
Separate advisory namespace (2, uid) never contends with reservation quota (1, uid)
Account stays disabled even if downstream cleanup throws; SSE drops on commit
6 Real Bugs One-Shot Code Misses (Proved in PRs)
findById() cached enabled=true before quota lock, missing concurrent disable
Fix: scalar JPQL findActiveRoleById after lock · FindActiveRoleFreshReadIT
Spring Proxy Bypass via default API Methods
default overload on ReservationApi self-invoked this, skipping @Transactional
Fix: deleted overloads + ArchUnit rule banning default in ..api..
extend locked Asset→Res while return locked Res→Asset; acceptTransfer inverted order
Fix: unified Reservation → Asset → Transfer order · ReservationConcurrencyIT
Batch Tx Rollback After Email Sent
Concurrent cancel on booking #2 rolled back booking #1 after notification fired
Fix: REQUIRES_NEW per booking + noRollbackFor · ReassignmentRollbackIT
Parallel AssetDamagedEvent + AssetRetiredEvent moved the same booking twice
Fix: expectedSourceAssetId guard under FOR UPDATE · AssetRetiredReassignmentIT
Parallel reports bypassed max-3 cap; 1-thread @Scheduled stalled 20s SSE :hb
Fix: advisory lock (2, uid) + 3-thread campus-sched- pool · IncidentQuotaConcurrencyIT
